{{Quote|Any idea why they sent you?''"<br />"''The Supreme Chancellor thinks you're wasted out here, beyond that, I don't know. My guess is that you're in for a promotion. Whole war is changing.|Jace Malcom asks the Jedi Knight why he was chosen to recall him|<ref name="TLBoCJM" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Jedi Knight''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]], he was sent by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] to recall [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] from the [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|front lines]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]] and bring him to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] fought through half a dozen [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]] to arrive at Kalandis Seven. After the Knight left the planet with his passenger, they conversed about why Malcom had been recalled and the possible future of the battle on Kalandis Seven.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual was part of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] he had achieved the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}} As [[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]] takes place between the [[Battle of Corellia]] and the [[Battle of Ilum]], it must occur in [[3640 BBY]].</ref> sometime after the [[Battle of Corellia]], he was personally selected by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] to recall [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] from the [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|front lines]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]] and [[Transport/Legends|transport]] him to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. He was then given the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Frontier Justice]]'' and had to fight through half a dozen [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]] to arrive on schedule.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

After he collected Malcom, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight proceeded to bring the Colonel to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet. During the flight, the Colonel asked the Knight why he had been recalled, to which the Knight replied that he had no idea and ventured a guess that Malcom was being promoted. They discussed the situation on Kalandis Seven, of which Malcom was sure that the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] would be unable to hold the planet, and the Jedi responded by saying that Malcom did not know what would happen.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Personality and traits==
The Jedi Knight was gifted in [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]], as evidenced when he repaired the [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] console of his ship. He was also patient and did not care about others' looks.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Knight was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and published in [[2012]].<ref name="Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> The Knight later appeared in author [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story, ''[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]'', which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 137|137th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> on [[October 23]], [[2012]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/137|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #137}}</ref> Alexander Freed thought of establishing the Knight as a character from ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released on [[December 20]], [[2011]], when he was creating the character, but in the end chose not to.<ref name="Alexander Freed's Twitter">{{Twitter|AlexanderMFreed|status/290661321299591168|[[Alexander Freed]]|quote=Q: 'Did you ever have a name/species chosen for the Jedi Knight that collects Malcom in the Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom?' A: 'I did not. (I thought about establishing him as someone from the game, but chose not to. His identity remains ambiguous!)'|archivefile=File:Freed Twitter.jpg}}</ref>
